notes.title: Online Services Update now Live
notes.notes:
Dear HyperBrawlers,

Due to the loss of support for our third-party backend service provider we have updated the game to replace some of the lost functionality. Unfortunately, some features of the game could not be replaced and the following feature has been lost:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards – All player Leaderboards, including Weekly and All-Time Leaderboards have been removed from the game. 
[/list]
Congratulations to those who topped these prestigious leaderboards in the past, your names will forever be associated with greatness!

To reflect the loss of the leaderboard feature, we have decided to reduce the price of the game as follows: £4.99 / $5.99 / €5.99.

Thank you for your continued support – The Milky Tea team

notes.title: The Winter Update and RRP Price Drop are Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]The latest HyperBrawl Tournament Team Select Update has arrived with a brand new lower price and even an extra 50% off for a limited time only![/h2]

[previewyoutube=WGn1O6HQEhI;full][/previewyoutube]
The holiday season is all about having fun with friends and family and whether that's online or together around a big screen TV, we have you covered with our local multiplayer couch play mode, private lobby
online mode or our competitive online Blitz tournament. We've even got an epic single player Campaign with over 7hrs of gameplay!

To make HyperBrawl Tournament more accessible than ever we've decided to [b]reduce the price of the game [u]for good  [/u][/b]- so take the opportunity to get your friends involved and start your journey to HyperBrawl Tournament glory!

[h3]The Update[/h3]
The new lower price is only half the story as we release a brand new [b]FREE[/b] update which includes the following:
[list]
[*] New Team Setup Feature - Assemble your ultimate team in the Main Menu to enable you to rapidly jump straight into your next Arcade, Blitz and Private match without additional setup.
[*] Global Matchmaking - Online multiplayer matchmaking is now global to make sure you can easily find your next opponent. You can still set a specific region if you want via the Settings menu.
[*] New Leaderboard and Objective Rewards - Earn new and additional rewards for topping the Leaderboard and completing daily objectives, including XP, credits, and Cosmetics.
[/list]
Thanks again for all the support and make sure you have fun, stay safe and we'll see you in the arena!
- The Milky Tea team

notes.title: An Important Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi brawlers!

This week we've got a few different things to share, so take a look below for all the latest from HyperBrawl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27827094/33c6a09eda96d776b4f1aba0b6efcda3f8d677ef.png[/img]

[h2]Release Date Update[/h2]
While we were extremely excited for our planned summer release, we've unfortunately had to make the difficult devision to delay the launch of HyperBrawl Tournament. With the ongoing pandemic and our team currently working completely remotely, meeting an already tight schedule to release the game on multiple platforms has not been easy, so we've had to delay the launch until fall 2020.

We do apologise for any disappointment that may come of this, and thank you for your patience while we put the finishing touches on the game in order to deliver the best possible experience later this year.

Please keep an eye on our channels for all the latest information.

[h2]Our latest brawl[/h2]
Our delay might have pushed back the release of HyperBrawl, but it didn't prevent us from taking to the arena for some hyper-futuristic brawling. This week I'm taking on our programmer, Dave, who uh.... is certainly better at HyperBrawl than me! Check out the video below to learn more about HyperBrawl from a programming perspective, while checking out some new gameplay footage!

[previewyoutube=SeiMouMi8BA;full][/previewyoutube]
To be notified about our next live brawl, consider following us on [b]Twitch[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/milkyteastudio]right here.[/url] If you want [b]even more[/b], you can check out the Weekly Brawl playlist on [b]YouTube[/b] [url=https://bit.ly/WeeklyBrawl]here[/url].

Be sure to follow us on [url=http://www.twitter.com/hyperbrawl]Twitter[/url] or join us on [url=http://discord.gg/hyperbrawl]Discord[/url] for the latest news as well as the occasional tips and tricks. Finally, as always, if you haven't already, please consider [b]Wishlisting[/b] HyperBrawl on Steam - it really helps!

See you in the arena!
